QLabel.name: manager_intro
QLabel.text: Monitor editor: this shows the selected monitor's EDID broken into sections. Changes here only update the working EDID until you install it as an override.

QPushButton.name: manager_edit_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Open advanced editors for the selected monitor's working EDID.

QPushButton.name: manager_copy_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Copy the selected monitor's working EDID.

QPushButton.name: manager_paste_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Install the copied EDID as an override for the selected monitor.

QPushButton.name: manager_delete_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Remove only the EDID override for the selected monitor.

QPushButton.name: manager_delete_monitor_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Remove EDID_OVERRIDE and EDID_RECOVERY data only. Active EDID is preserved.

QPushButton.name: manager_refresh_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Reload monitor entries and EDID data from Windows.

QGroupBox.name: established_group
QGroupBox.title: Established resolutions
QGroupBox.tooltip: Old compatibility modes advertised by the monitor. Usually safe to leave alone.

QListWidget.name: manager_established_list
QListWidget.tooltip: Old compatibility modes advertised by the monitor. Usually safe to leave alone.

QLabel.name: manager_summary_label
QLabel.text: Select a monitor to see what its EDID advertises.

QGroupBox.name: detailed_group
QGroupBox.title: Detailed resolutions
QGroupBox.tooltip: Exact video modes. The first one is usually the preferred/native mode.

QListWidget.name: manager_detailed_list
QListWidget.tooltip: Exact video modes. The first one is usually the preferred/native mode.

QGroupBox.name: standard_group
QGroupBox.title: Standard resolutions
QGroupBox.tooltip: Older compact resolution entries. Modern displays often have none.

QListWidget.name: manager_standard_list
QListWidget.tooltip: Older compact resolution entries. Modern displays often have none.

QGroupBox.name: extension_group
QGroupBox.title: Extension blocks
QGroupBox.tooltip: Extra EDID blocks for HDMI/DisplayID/HDR/audio/VRR and other capabilities.

QListWidget.name: manager_extension_list
QListWidget.tooltip: Extra EDID blocks for HDMI/DisplayID/HDR/audio/VRR and other capabilities.
